hypotheses.Q1_manual_attention_and_factor_recomposi: Manual squared attention matches the native attention write, and all four changed factors recompose the changed attention write, to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.Q2_query_routing_dominates_self_key_rout: At every audited layer and corpus, query allocation exceeds key allocation in absolute local attention-write projection.
hypotheses.Q3_routing_dominates_values: At at least eight of eleven layers on every corpus, absolute query-plus-key local allocation exceeds current-value-plus-bus allocation.
hypotheses.Q4_persistent_bus_is_not_the_main_value_: At every layer and corpus, current-value allocation is at least as large as persistent-bus allocation in absolute local projection.
hypotheses.Q5_insertion_and_removal_agree_on_top_fa: At every layer and corpus, insertion and removal causal Shapley select the same largest absolute factor.
hypotheses.Q6_attention_effect_is_head_concentrated: At some layer on every corpus, one head receives at least 0.50 of absolute local head projection mass.
hypotheses.Q7_isolated_heads_add_approximately: At every layer and corpus, summing isolated head logit effects has Fisher fidelity at least 0.80 to the complete attention-change intervention.
hypotheses.Q8_attention_only_behavior_is_small: At every layer and corpus, insertion of the complete changed attention write causes at most 0.10 of the native full-token forward KL.
